notes: Drive Engine Lv2 is the practical mobility threshold for leaving the starting planet.
Birth theme has zero titanium vein spots and no recipe produces Titanium Ore; sustained titanium therefore requires access beyond the starter planet.
Birth theme has zero silicon vein spots, but recipe 34 provides a 10 Stone -> 1 Silicon Ore fallback; off-world access is an efficiency/scale gate rather than an absolute silicon gate.
Planetary Logistics System unlocks the station/drone production branch.
Interstellar Logistics System unlocks ILS and Logistics Vessel recipes.
Drive Engine Lv4's prerequisite closure includes Mecha Core Lv4 and Gravitational Wave Refraction.
Logistics Carrier Engine Lv4 has implicit prerequisite Drive Engine Lv4.
